text.content:
A Unstable alcove, quiet enough that it's clearly been used as a waypoint by more than one previous expedition.

GM Notes

Substory beat: A half-transmuted survivor is trapped between forms in a side chamber, begging for the process to be reversed or finished.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 15 to detect and counter).
